notes.title: Jelli Nook - Craft Adorable Jellies!
notes.content: [h1][b][i][u]Jelli Nook[/u][/i][/b][/h1][h2][b][i]Gameplay Demo & Dev Commentary[/i][/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583797/aa74fce886ab093af4fe8f7fb46a8155f456e575.png"][/img][/p][h3][u]Demo time![/u][/h3][p]Join us live during [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] for an exclusive first look at our playable demo. We’ll be showing off the magic of crafting adorable Jellies, using unique and fun ingredients. Can you discover all 18 recipes for the cute Jelli creations available in the demo? If so, you'll have a blast puzzling through all [b][u]100 recipes in the full game![/u][/b][/p][h3][/h3][h3][u]Chat with Xander! [/u][/h3][p][b]Xander[/b] is our awesome audio aficionado. He'll take you through the amazing soundtrack for [b]Jelli Nook[/b], our planned updates and final features including [b][u]shop unlocks[/u][/b] and a special [b][u]photography mode[/u][/b]![/p][h3][/h3][h3][u]Inspiration [/u][/h3][p][b]Jelli Nook[/b] in inspired by [b]Little Alchemy[/b], the cooking mechanic from [b]Breath of the Wild[/b], and [b]Slime Rancher[/b]. If you enjoy simple puzzles, cute creatures, and exploring what works and what doesn't, this [b]tiny, cozy crafting game[/b] is for you! [/p][p][/p][h3][u]Release Date[/u][/h3][p]We plan to release [b]Jelli Nook[/b] near the end of Q3, start of Q4 of this year (2025).[/p][p][/p][p](Don't forget to squish the Jellies or they'll be upset with you!)[/p]
